sparse_policy._comment: Sparse session-worktree profile (research/WORKTREE_GC_POLICY.md §0 R8). Read by .claude/hooks/worktree_create_sparse.py when minting a Claude worktree; by Codex (.codex/environments/environment.toml + .codex/hooks.json), Cursor IDE (.cursor/hooks.json sessionStart/workspaceOpen), Cursor CLI (.cursor/worktrees.json), Grok (.grok/hooks/session_start_sparse.py via sparse-worktree.json, plus the always-trusted ~/.grok/hooks copy that AionUi sessions load), and Warp/Oz (.warp/hooks/session_start_sparse.py plus .agents/skills/macro-sparse-worktree — Warp has no SessionStart event) through scripts/worktree_sparse.py auto/mint; and by the operator CLI (status/full/sparse/add/clean). JSON (not yml) so the lifecycle hooks run on a bare system python3 with no pyyaml — same constraint as config/worktree_gc.json. enabled:false disables automatic sparse creation/conversion; that and any change to exclude_dirs are one-line acts. Excluding a directory here NEVER hides it from git: the paths stay tracked, `git status` stays clean (skip-worktree), and any session opts back in with `python3 scripts/worktree_sparse.py full`.
sparse_policy._measured_2026_08_13: Full session worktree = 3.8 GiB: data/ 2.3 + site/ 0.73 + mockups/ 0.23 + verify_shots/ 0.05 = 3.31 GiB (87%) of generated artifacts a typical session never reads. Sparse tree measures ~0.35-0.57 GiB, an ~7-11x cut. R8's own 2026-08-05 figures (3.27 GiB, data 2.10 + site 0.67 = 85%) are the same finding one week earlier; the tree has grown since.
sparse_policy._exclude_rationale: R8 names data/ + site/. mockups/ and verify_shots/ are the same CLASS — committed rendered artifacts and screenshot evidence, not code — and cost another 0.28 GiB/tree, so they ship excluded too and this line is the audit trail for that widening. Trimming back to exactly R8's two is a one-line edit here; the cost is ~0.28 GiB x ~40 trees/day = ~11 GiB/day of standing set. Design work that needs the specimen (mockups/design_system/specimen.html) or shot evidence runs `python3 scripts/worktree_sparse.py add mockups`.
